tokens.title: API keys
tokens.description: Keys let outside tools such as Stream Deck, Touch Portal or your own scripts use this channel. Paired devices show here too.
tokens.empty: No keys yet. Make one to connect a tool.
tokens.error: The keys could not be loaded.

create.title: New API key
create.description: Choose what the key may do. You see the key once, right after you make it.
create.name: Name
create.scopesHelp: Give a key only what the tool needs. Speak as the bot lets the tool post chat messages.
create.pipelinesHelp: Pick none to allow every pipeline.
create.expiresHelp: Leave empty for a key that does not end.

secret.title: Key for {name}
secret.description: Copy this key now. The bot keeps only a fingerprint, so you cannot see it again.

rotate.title: Make a new secret for {name}?
rotate.description: The tool needs the new secret before it can connect again.
rotate.consequence: The old secret stops working right away.

revoke.title: Revoke {name}?
revoke.description: The key stays in the list as revoked.
revoke.consequence: Any tool or device that uses this key loses access right away. A paired device is unpaired.

pairing.title: Pair a device
pairing.description: Connect a Stream Deck or another device without copying a key by hand.

mint.title: Make a code for the device
mint.expires: Type it into the device before {time}. It works once.

approve.title: Approve a device code
approve.done: Device approved. It appears in the key list.

events.title: Events this key can listen to
events.error: The events could not be loaded.
